info.title: Macro Tracker API
info.description: User-scoped API for normal Macro Tracker objects. Every response is the same envelope: `{"ok": true, "data": ...}` on success, `{"ok": false, "error": {"code", "message"}}` otherwise. 405 is a property of the path rather than of one operation: any known path answers an unsupported method with 405 and an `Allow` header, so every operation lists it. Any request may additionally receive 413 (body over 2 MB) or 504 (the 30 second request deadline elapsed). The whole /api/v1 surface — including this document — sits behind a per-client rate limit and answers 429 when it is exceeded.

get.summary: Read the authenticated account and goals

post.summary: Create a meal entry on a date
post.description: The entry date is taken from the path segment. A `date` in the body is ignored.

patch.description: Additionally requires read:foods when non-null productId is supplied.

data.description: Null when no product is known for the barcode.

post.summary: Apply a template to a date
Create a template from a day

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token. Available scopes: read:account, read:daily, write:daily, read:foods, write:foods, read:templates, write:templates, read:recipes, write:recipes, read:weight, write:weight, read:goals, write:goals, read:stats

Account.description: The account fields the public API exposes. Internal columns such as the identity-provider subject and the role are not part of this surface.

productId.description: Null once the linked product is deleted.

sourceLabel.description: Name of the linked product, when there is one.

FoodProduct.description: Curation columns (owning user, submitter, provenance and moderation fields) are stripped before the product leaves the public API.

GoalHitRate.description: Percentage of days in the window that met each goal.

Forbidden.description: Insufficient token scope, or onboarding not completed

MethodNotAllowed.description: The path exists but does not allow this method; the response carries an Allow header

TooManyRequests.description: The client exceeded the /api/v1 request rate limit

GatewayTimeout.description: The request exceeded the 30 second deadline
